plan.cover_image_prompt: reception desk of a local medical clinic, patient arranging an appointment, realistic photo, warm indoor light, no text, no logos, no faces in close-up

scenes.topic_description:
Situation: The learner contacts a local clinic reception desk to book a doctor's appointment. It is the third day of a sore throat and fever, and the learner needs a convenient appointment time soon.
Learner: the learner is a patient. Partner: the partner is a receptionist.
Learner must be able to: say they need a doctor's appointment; briefly explain the problem as sore throat and fever for three days; ask about available times and choose a convenient one; understand simple questions about name, phone number, and time.
Partner will: offer available appointment times; ask what the problem is and how urgent it is; confirm the booking details.
Not in this scene: describing symptoms in detail, answering the doctor's medical questions, diagnosis, treatment instructions, medicine.
scenes.image_prompt: clinic reception desk with appointment calendar and patient speaking to receptionist, realistic photo, no text, no logos, no faces in close-up

scenes.topic_description:
Situation: The learner is at the doctor's appointment after booking it. This is a basic consultation about a sore throat and fever that have lasted for three days.
Learner: the learner is a patient. Partner: the partner is a doctor.
Learner must be able to: describe the main symptoms simply, including sore throat, fever, and how long they have lasted; answer basic questions such as whether the learner has a cough or other pain; understand simple advice about rest, fluids, and medicine; ask one or two basic follow-up questions if something is unclear.
Partner will: ask about symptoms and duration; say what the learner should do next; give simple treatment advice or tell the learner to buy medicine.
Not in this scene: booking the appointment, choosing a time, giving contact details, paying at reception, buying medicine at a pharmacy.
scenes.image_prompt: doctor's office during a basic consultation, patient talking to physician across a desk, realistic photo, no text, no logos, no faces in close-up
